book.name: Mateo
book.title: To Madojow no Nawnangonon no Sinuyat ni Mateo

content: To Pananglitan to Kumbiti
Nang-anad si Jesus to duma no pananglitan. Kagi din,
“To paghari to Diyus ogkaangod to seini. Meyduon hari no mighinaat to kumbiti su ogminyo to anak din.
Pigsugu din to mgo suguonon to pagsuna to diya mgo inimbita din, di sikan mgo inimbita migbalibad.

“Dajun sugu-a to sikan hari to duma no mgo suguonon aw ikagihi, ‘Nangoni sikan mgo inimbita ku no naandam on to tibo. Namatansa on to mgo baka dow pinataba no mgo nati aw nayutu on. Kaling paandinihon on sikandan.’
Di sikan mgo inimbita wada pamanlipara. Nasi sikandan migpanow. Mey mig-andiya to uma, aw mey mig-atiman to nigusyu din.
To mgo duma namandakop to sikan mgo suguonon to hari aw paantusa ayha himataji.
Pagkataga to sikan hari, hilabi sikandin naboyu. Kaling impapuu to mgo sundayu din sikan namanhimatoy to mgo suguonon aw ipasangab to yunsud dan.
“Tapus to sikan, pig-ikagihan to sikan hari to mgo suguonon din, ‘Nabotad on seini kumbiti, di to diya mgo inimbita ku kona no angajan og-andini.
Na, andiya kow to karsada aw imbitaha to inggad hintawa no mabaekan now.’
Dajun andiya sikan mgo suguonon to karsada aw pandaeha to tibo mgo otow no nabaekan dan no mangkadojow dow mangkadoot to batasan. Na, naponu to mgo otow sikan bayoy no pigkumbitihan.
“Di pagsed to sikan hari su og-abi-abihon din sikan mgo imbitadu, meyduon pigkita din no wada sul-ub to diya kabo no igpasul-ub to og-agpot to kumbitihan.
Kagi to sikan hari, ‘Yagi, pig-amonu nu man to pagsed kani no wada nu man kabo-a to diya angay kani to kumbitihan?’ Di wada ingkatabak to sikan otow.
Dajun sugu-a to sikan hari to mgo suguonon din, ‘Gapusa to boyad dow kobong din aw ibegbog diya to kadigyoman diya to yuwas. Ogpakadegmatoy to mgo otow duon aw ogkagot to ngipon dan.’
“Na, mahan-in to mgo otow no ogtawagon to Diyus, di pipilahon da to ogkahinang no mgo sakup din.”
To Pagbajad to Buhis
Dajun panow to mgo Pariseo su ogplanu dow og-amonuhon dan to pagbitik ki Jesus.

Migsugu sikandan to pila no mgo sakup dan dow sakup to partidu ni Hari Herodes diya ki Jesus. Kagi dan, “Sir, namaan koy no matinod-anon ka, aw matuud yagboy to igpang-anad nu bahin to pagtuman to Diyus. Inggad hintawa to igpag-atubang nu, pinag-angod nu to pagpang-anad kandan su wada ogpayabihon nu.
Na, nokoy man to hona-hona nu to seini? Kona buwa no supak to tinuuhan ta to pagbajad to buhis diya to hari to Roma?”
Di namaan si Jesus no madoot to tuud dan kaling mig-ikagi sikandin, “Kunungkun mgo diyusnon! Nokoy no og-antihan a now man?
Na, ipakita kanay to saepi no babajaday to buhis.” Dajun dan itadwoy kandin to saepi.
Mig-usip si Jesus, “Hintawa man bayhu
dow ngadan to nakabotang kani to seini?”
Kagi dan, “Kaning hari to Roma.” Kagi ni Jesus, “Na, ibogoy to hari to kaning hari, aw ibogoy isab to Diyus to kaning Diyus.”
Pagdinog dan to sikan, hilabi sikandan natingaya aw dajun panow.
To Pagkabanhaw to mgo Patoy
Sikan no aedow meyduon isab mgo Saduseo no mig-anduon ki Jesus su ogpangusip. Na, sikan no mgo otawa naman-iling no kona ogkabanhaw to mgo patoy. Kagi dan ki Jesus,

“Sir, mig-iling to balaod no imbilin ni Moises no ko mamatoy to otow no ogkabilin to asawa no wada pad anak, kinahangyan asawahon to suun din sikan bohi agun meyduon ogkailing no liwat to diya namatoy.
Na, igpananglit ta to pitu no migsusuun no mgo yukos kani kanami. Naminyo sikan panganoy, di wada pad anak dan, namatoy on sikandin. Kaling pig-asawa to hadi din sikan bohi no nabayu,

di namatoy isab sikandin no wada pad anak. Angod isab to nahitabu to sikan ikatoyu. Na, yaktod no pagkaikagi, sikan pitu no migsusuun tibo nakaasawa to sikan bohi aw tibo sikandan namatoy no wada anak.
To katapusan, namatoy isab sikan bohi.
Na, ojow nu pa, ogbanhawon to mgo patoy. Ko matuman on sikan, hintawa man yagboy to sikan pitu to ogkatawag no tag-asawa to sikan bohi, su tibo man sikandan nakaasawa kandin?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Pagkasajop now yagboy! Su wada kow makasabut to Kasuyatan to Diyus dow to gahom din.
Su ko banhawon on to mgo patoy, wadad on og-inasawahay, su ogkaangod on man sikandan to mgo anghil diya to yangit.
Na, sikiyu no kona ogtuu no ogkabanhaw to mgo patoy, ajaw og-ilinga no wada kow makabasa to kagi to Diyus iyu duon to Kasuyatan din no pig-iling,
‘Siak no Diyus iyan ogsimbahon ni Abraham, ni Isaac dow ni Jacob.’
Migpasabut no inggad nayugoy da kamatoy sikan no mgo otow, buhi gihapun sikandan diya to yangit su ogpadajun man to pagsimba to Diyus. Su to mgo patoy konad ogsimba to Diyus, mgo buhi da.”
Pagdinog to kaotawan to sikan no pagpang-anad ni Jesus, naboyong yagboy sikandan.
To Pinakaimpurtanti no mgo Sugu to Diyus
Pagkamaan to mgo Pariseo no wada ingkatabak to sikan mgo Saduseo ki Jesus, mighihimun dajun sikandan aw andiya isab ki Jesus.
Sobuuk kandan no maistru to tinuuhan mig-anti ki Jesus,
“Sir, duon to sikan tibo mgo balaod to Diyus, andei man to pinakaimpurtanti?”
Migtabak si Jesus, “Seini: ‘Higugmaa to Ginuu no Diyus nu to bug-us no ginhawa dow hona-hona nu aw tibuuk no kinabuhi nu.’
Sikan to pinakaimpurtanti no sugu.
To ikaduwa no pinakaimpurtanti ogpakaangod to sikan su pig-iling, ‘Higugmaa to isigkaotow nu angod to paghigugma to kaugalingon nu.’
Migsikad duon to sikan daduwa no mgo sugu to tibo mgo balaod no impabaja ki Moises dow to tibo impang-anad to diya kibali mgo ba-ba to Diyus.”
Sikan Insaad no Manyuyuwas
Pig-ikagihan ni Jesus sikan mgo Pariseo no nahimun,
“Og-usip a iyu bahin to diya Insaad no Manyuyuwas.
Hintawa man sikandin no kaliwat?” Kagi dan, “Kaliwat ni Hari David.”
“Na,” kagi ni Jesus, “ko mailing to sikan, nokoy no mig-iling man si David no Ginuu din sikan Insaad no Manyuyuwas? Su si David no minanduan to Ispiritu Santu iyan man yagboy mig-iling,

content.text: ‘To Ginuu no Agayon ku pig-ikagihan to Diyus,
Ingkud ka kani to kalintuu no takidingan ku
kotob no daogon ku yagboy to mgo kuntra nu
aw makayuhud duon to atubangan nu.’

content: Kagi ni Jesus, “Manno Agayon to intawag ni David to sikan Insaad no Manyuyuwas, nokoy no ogkailing man no kaliwat puli sikandin ni David?”
Di wada nakatabak kandin. Aw sugud to diya no aedow, wadad nakayangub to pagpangusip kandin.
